name: 3d-interior-design-generator
description: Root scripts to install and run the backend API and frontend UI together as a single local application.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
